prompt: From 3pm onwards, send a payment to review if it is either non-UPI or the user has made at most 3 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 15 AND (txn.method != UPI OR txn.count_1h <= 3) THEN REVIEW reason="late_hours_upi_method"

prompt: Block KYC-verified users on devices that are not rooted when the account is under six months old.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND user.kyc_verified AND user.account_age_days < 180 THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_kyc_verified"

prompt: Reject it if the amount is above 25k, or if it's 8pm or later. Either one is enough.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 25000 OR txn.hour >= 20 THEN BLOCK reason="high_amount_late_hours"

prompt: We don't take payments to travel, utilities or food merchants.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [TRAVEL, UTILITIES, FOOD] THEN BLOCK reason="listed_merchant"

prompt: Payments to travel, electronics or utilities merchants from a device first seen less than 45 days ago should go to review.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [TRAVEL, ELECTRONICS, UTILITIES] AND device.age_days < 45 THEN REVIEW reason="listed_merchant_low_device"

prompt: Any payment under ₹1500 from an account that is 21 days old or more must be blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.amount < 1500 AND user.account_age_days >= 21 THEN BLOCK reason="low_amount_high_account"

prompt: Utility bills can only be paid with a wallet. Decline every other method for utilities merchants.
rule: WHEN txn.method != WALLET AND merchant.category == UTILITIES THEN BLOCK reason="wallet_method_utilities_merchant"

prompt: Review it when the account is under a week old and the device has been seen for at least a day.
rule: WHEN device.age_days >= 1 AND user.account_age_days < 7 THEN REVIEW reason="high_device_low_account"

prompt: Anything over 7,500 rupees, or any domestic payment, gets sent for review.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 7500 OR NOT txn.is_international THEN REVIEW reason="high_amount_domestic"

prompt: Hold for review when the user has had at most 1 failed attempt in 24 hours, no more than 15 payments in the last hour, and either the amount is under 7500 or the phone is rooted.
rule: WHEN (txn.amount < 7500 OR device.is_rooted) AND user.failed_attempts_24h <= 1 AND txn.count_1h <= 15 THEN REVIEW reason="low_amount_rooted_device"

prompt: International payments by KYC-verified users with fewer than 10 failed attempts in the last 24 hours must be blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND user.kyc_verified AND user.failed_attempts_24h < 10 THEN BLOCK reason="international_kyc_verified"

prompt: Stop it if any one of these is true: wallet payment, account under a week old, or device not rooted.
rule: WHEN txn.method == WALLET OR user.account_age_days < 7 OR NOT device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="wallet_method_low_account"

prompt: New device doing 30 or more payments in one hour? Put it in front of a reviewer.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 30 AND device.age_days < 7 THEN REVIEW reason="high_txns_new_device"

prompt: Deny payments above 20 lakh to merchants that aren't whitelisted, when the user made at most 3 payments in the last hour and had no more than 15 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h <= 3 AND user.failed_attempts_24h <= 15 AND txn.amount > 2000000 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="low_txns_low_failures"

prompt: International payments before 6pm get blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 18 AND txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="early_hours_international"

prompt: If the amount is over 12000, the device isn't rooted and the user has no failed attempts in the last 24 hours, reject it.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.amount > 12000 AND user.failed_attempts_24h == 0 THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_high_amount"

prompt: For merchants outside the trusted list, we block the payment if the user hasn't passed KYC or the amount is ₹100 or more.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND (NOT user.kyc_verified OR txn.amount >= 100) THEN BLOCK reason="unlisted_merchant_no_kyc"

prompt: Card or wallet payments above 50 lakh to a whitelisted merchant are blocked if the user already made more than 6 payments in the past hour.
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND txn.method IN [CARD, WALLET] AND txn.amount > 5000000 AND txn.count_1h > 6 THEN BLOCK reason="whitelisted_merchant_listed_method"

prompt: Rooted device + new account + ₹500 or less -> review
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND user.account_age_days < 30 AND txn.amount <= 500 THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_device_new_account"

prompt: Reject international travel payments made at night by users with 8 or more failed attempts in the past day.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 8 AND txn.is_international AND txn.hour < 6 AND merchant.category == TRAVEL THEN BLOCK reason="high_failures_international"

prompt: Verified users on non-rooted devices can't pay more than 3 lakh rupees.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND user.kyc_verified AND txn.amount > 300000 THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_kyc_verified"

prompt: Block international payments to non-whitelisted merchants. Also block everything, whatever the merchant, when the user has fewer than 15 failed attempts in the last 24 hours.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND NOT merchant.whitelisted OR user.failed_attempts_24h < 15 THEN BLOCK reason="international_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: Rooted devices on accounts at least two years old: block.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days >= 730 AND device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="high_account_rooted_device"

prompt: Please send to manual review any payment of up to 30k that is a wallet payment or comes from a device that is not rooted.
rule: WHEN (NOT device.is_rooted OR txn.method == WALLET) AND txn.amount <= 30000 THEN REVIEW reason="unrooted_device_wallet_method"

prompt: Let the payment through if it is UPI, or if the user has failed 10 or more times in the last day.
rule: WHEN txn.method == UPI OR user.failed_attempts_24h >= 10 THEN ALLOW reason="upi_method_high_failures"

prompt: Approve in any of these cases: more than 20 failed attempts in 24 hours, an amount above 1 lakh, or the phone being rooted.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h > 20 OR txn.amount > 100000 OR device.is_rooted THEN ALLOW reason="high_failures_high_amount"

prompt: Not-whitelisted merchant and non-rooted device? A human should look at it.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="unrooted_device_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: Under 7500, device first seen under 180 days ago, and either at most 5 payments in the last hour or between 2am and 6am: block.
rule: WHEN txn.amount < 7500 AND device.age_days < 180 AND (txn.count_1h <= 5 OR txn.hour >= 2 AND txn.hour < 6) THEN BLOCK reason="low_amount_low_device"

prompt: Anyone whose account is 60 days old or more gets rejected.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days >= 60 THEN BLOCK reason="high_account"

prompt: KYC-verified user, 4 or more payments in the last hour, no more than 20 failed attempts in 24 hours. Review these.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h <= 20 AND user.kyc_verified AND txn.count_1h >= 4 THEN REVIEW reason="low_failures_kyc_verified"

prompt: Turn away KYC-verified users when either the account is at least two weeks old or the time is 2pm or later.
rule: WHEN (user.account_age_days >= 14 OR txn.hour >= 14) AND user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="high_account_late_hours"

prompt: Card payments from non-rooted devices to whitelisted merchants get blocked once the user hits 5 or more payments in an hour.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.count_1h >= 5 AND txn.method == CARD AND merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_high_txns"

prompt: Accounts under 21 days old with fewer than 5 failed attempts in the last 24 hours must be blocked.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 21 AND user.failed_attempts_24h < 5 THEN BLOCK reason="low_account_low_failures"

prompt: For a user making 20 or more payments in an hour, send it for review if the merchant is grocery or the user has 15 or more failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 20 AND (merchant.category == GROCERY OR user.failed_attempts_24h >= 15) THEN REVIEW reason="high_txns_grocery_merchant"

prompt: Stop payments of 1 crore or more from devices first seen 120 days ago or less.
rule: WHEN device.age_days <= 120 AND txn.amount >= 10000000 THEN BLOCK reason="low_device_high_amount"

prompt: Block if the phone is rooted, if it's international, or if the user has made no more than 25 payments in the last hour. Any one is enough.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted OR txn.count_1h <= 25 OR txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="rooted_device_low_txns"

prompt: Payments of 12,000 rupees or more are fine, let them pass.
rule: WHEN txn.amount >= 12000 THEN ALLOW reason="high_amount"

prompt: Unverified users paying by card or UPI at night are allowed through.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.method IN [CARD, UPI] AND txn.hour < 6 THEN ALLOW reason="no_kyc_listed_method"

prompt: Review netbanking, card or UPI payments when the device has been around for at least 2 days and the user has at most 4 failed attempts in the last 24 hours.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h <= 4 AND device.age_days >= 2 AND txn.method IN [NETBANKING, CARD, UPI] THEN REVIEW reason="low_failures_high_device"

prompt: Non-KYC users on a device first seen more than 3 days ago are blocked for payments of 12,000 or less.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND device.age_days > 3 AND txn.amount <= 12000 THEN BLOCK reason="no_kyc_high_device"

prompt: Decline when the account is older than 3 days and the user has made at most 10 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days > 3 AND txn.count_1h <= 10 THEN BLOCK reason="high_account_low_txns"

prompt: It's okay to allow international payments to whitelisted merchants even from a rooted phone.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND merchant.whitelisted AND device.is_rooted THEN ALLOW reason="international_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: Rooted phones or overnight payments: send to review.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted OR txn.hour < 6 THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_device_night"

prompt: Non-gaming merchant, neither UPI nor wallet, before 7am, account up to two years old. Review it.
rule: WHEN merchant.category != GAMING AND NOT txn.method IN [UPI, WALLET] AND txn.hour < 7 AND user.account_age_days <= 730 THEN REVIEW reason="gaming_merchant_listed_method"

prompt: Electronics purchases from a device less than a day old are not allowed.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == ELECTRONICS AND device.age_days < 1 THEN BLOCK reason="electronics_merchant_low_device"

prompt: Trusted merchant, device 120 days old or less: block.
rule: WHEN device.age_days <= 120 AND merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="low_device_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: If the user hasn't done KYC and the account is at least 2 days old, block payments to any merchant except electronics.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days >= 2 AND merchant.category != ELECTRONICS AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="high_account_electronics_merchant"

prompt: Grocery payments are not accepted. We also block payments to whitelisted merchants when the device is new.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 7 AND merchant.whitelisted OR merchant.category == GROCERY THEN BLOCK reason="new_device_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: Anyone without KYC who has fewer than 20 failed attempts in the last 24 hours should be reviewed.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND user.failed_attempts_24h < 20 THEN REVIEW reason="no_kyc_low_failures"

prompt: Between 8pm and 11pm, a rooted device gets reviewed if the payment is by netbanking or the user has under 20 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND txn.hour >= 20 AND txn.hour < 23 AND (txn.method == NETBANKING OR user.failed_attempts_24h < 20) THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_device_window_hours"

prompt: International payments to whitelisted electronics merchants of up to 3 lakh are blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.amount <= 300000 AND merchant.category == ELECTRONICS AND merchant.whitelisted AND txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="low_amount_electronics_merchant"

prompt: Review payments up to 20k from non-rooted devices where the user has no failed attempts in the last 24 hours.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h == 0 AND txn.amount <= 20000 AND NOT device.is_rooted THEN REVIEW reason="no_failures_low_amount"

prompt: Any account 120 days old or older: reject.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days >= 120 THEN BLOCK reason="high_account"

prompt: Domestic card payments from KYC-verified users who have fewer than 2 failed attempts in 24 hours are allowed.
rule: WHEN txn.method == CARD AND NOT txn.is_international AND user.failed_attempts_24h < 2 AND user.kyc_verified THEN ALLOW reason="card_method_domestic"

prompt: Allow it for accounts at least 30 days old without KYC, provided the user has over 15 failed attempts in 24 hours or the payment is domestic.
rule: WHEN (user.failed_attempts_24h > 15 OR NOT txn.is_international) AND user.account_age_days >= 30 AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN ALLOW reason="high_failures_domestic"

prompt: Travel payments up to 2.5 lakh from a new device that isn't rooted can go through.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == TRAVEL AND device.age_days < 7 AND txn.amount <= 250000 AND NOT device.is_rooted THEN ALLOW reason="travel_merchant_new_device"

prompt: Unless the merchant is gaming or travel, block users who haven't completed KYC.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.category IN [GAMING, TRAVEL] AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="listed_merchant_no_kyc"

prompt: New accounts paying a non-whitelisted merchant need a manual review.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 30 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="new_account_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: Rooted device that was first seen at least 180 days ago -> review
rule: WHEN device.age_days >= 180 AND device.is_rooted THEN REVIEW reason="high_device_rooted_device"

prompt: Whitelisted merchant, between 6pm and 10pm, fewer than 8 failed attempts in 24 hours: block.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 18 AND txn.hour < 22 AND user.failed_attempts_24h < 8 AND merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="window_hours_low_failures"

prompt: Payments of 50k or more are blocked when the user has more than 10 failed attempts in 24 hours, the device is 730 days old or more, and the method is anything but netbanking.
rule: WHEN txn.amount >= 50000 AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 10 AND device.age_days >= 730 AND txn.method != NETBANKING THEN BLOCK reason="high_amount_high_failures"

prompt: Send UPI payments to review if the amount is at least 20k or the account is up to 30 days old.
rule: WHEN (txn.amount >= 20000 OR user.account_age_days <= 30) AND txn.method == UPI THEN REVIEW reason="high_amount_low_account"

prompt: Domestic payments on non-rooted devices from accounts at least a year old should be blocked if the user has made no more than 100 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.count_1h <= 100 AND NOT txn.is_international AND user.account_age_days >= 365 THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_low_txns"

prompt: Any merchant that is not food, with an account under six months old, gets reviewed.
rule: WHEN merchant.category != FOOD AND user.account_age_days < 180 THEN REVIEW reason="food_merchant_low_account"

prompt: No international payments at night.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 6 AND txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="night_international"

prompt: Travel or gaming payments from rooted devices older than 90 days get blocked when the user has more than 20 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN device.age_days > 90 AND device.is_rooted AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 20 AND merchant.category IN [TRAVEL, GAMING] THEN BLOCK reason="high_device_rooted_device"

prompt: Everything from 4pm onwards should go to review.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 16 THEN REVIEW reason="late_hours"

prompt: Users with more than 1 failed attempt, an account up to 45 days old, and a device first seen at least 180 days ago: deny.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h > 1 AND user.account_age_days <= 45 AND device.age_days >= 180 THEN BLOCK reason="high_failures_low_account"

prompt: New device and domestic payment: allow.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 7 AND NOT txn.is_international THEN ALLOW reason="new_device_domestic"

prompt: Cancel it if the device is older than 90 days and either the user isn't KYC-verified or has made 30 or more payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN (NOT user.kyc_verified OR txn.count_1h >= 30) AND device.age_days > 90 THEN BLOCK reason="no_kyc_high_txns"

prompt: Non-gaming card payments are allowed if the account is under a week old or the user is KYC-verified.
rule: WHEN merchant.category != GAMING AND txn.method == CARD AND (user.account_age_days < 7 OR user.kyc_verified) THEN ALLOW reason="gaming_merchant_card_method"

prompt: Review any non-netbanking payment made from 1pm onwards.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 13 AND txn.method != NETBANKING THEN REVIEW reason="late_hours_netbanking_method"

prompt: UPI international payments up to 40k on accounts under six months old are not allowed.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 180 AND txn.amount <= 40000 AND txn.method == UPI AND txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="low_account_low_amount"

prompt: It's fine to let international payments through when the user has made fewer than 100 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.count_1h < 100 THEN ALLOW reason="international_low_txns"

prompt: Payments to non-whitelisted merchants of at least 10,000 from a new device can pass if the user has fewer than 5 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h < 5 AND device.age_days < 7 AND txn.amount >= 10000 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="low_failures_new_device"

prompt: Rooted devices first seen at least 45 days ago get blocked when the user is KYC-verified and the time is before 11pm.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND device.age_days >= 45 AND user.kyc_verified AND txn.hour < 23 THEN BLOCK reason="rooted_device_high_device"

prompt: Not whitelisted, device 15 days old or less, rooted: review please.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND device.age_days <= 15 AND device.is_rooted THEN REVIEW reason="unlisted_merchant_low_device"

prompt: Between 6pm and 10pm, anything other than food merchants is blocked.
rule: WHEN merchant.category != FOOD AND txn.hour >= 18 AND txn.hour < 22 THEN BLOCK reason="food_merchant_window_hours"

prompt: Whitelisted merchant, user has 3 or more failed attempts in 24 hours, under 10 payments in the last hour, device under 90 days old. Send to review.
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND txn.count_1h < 10 AND user.failed_attempts_24h >= 3 AND device.age_days < 90 THEN REVIEW reason="whitelisted_merchant_low_txns"

prompt: Review if the device is rooted or the amount is 5000 or more.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted OR txn.amount >= 5000 THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_device_high_amount"

prompt: Devices at least 60 days old: review when the method is card or the amount is 50 lakh or more.
rule: WHEN device.age_days >= 60 AND (txn.method == CARD OR txn.amount >= 5000000) THEN REVIEW reason="high_device_card_method"

prompt: Non-international netbanking or card payments to gaming merchants are allowed when the user has no failed attempts in the last 24 hours.
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [NETBANKING, CARD] AND merchant.category == GAMING AND NOT txn.is_international AND user.failed_attempts_24h == 0 THEN ALLOW reason="listed_method_gaming_merchant"

prompt: Netbanking or card payments with at most 5 payments in the last hour should be reviewed when the merchant is whitelisted or it's 11pm or later.
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [NETBANKING, CARD] AND txn.count_1h <= 5 AND (merchant.whitelisted OR txn.hour >= 23) THEN REVIEW reason="listed_method_low_txns"

prompt: From 12 noon onwards, payments to gaming, travel or utilities merchants are blocked if the user has more than 6 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [GAMING, TRAVEL, UTILITIES] AND txn.hour >= 12 AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 6 THEN BLOCK reason="listed_merchant_late_hours"

prompt: Whitelisted non-food merchants on a non-rooted device get approved when the user has made 25 or more payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND merchant.category != FOOD AND txn.count_1h >= 25 AND merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="unrooted_device_food_merchant"

prompt: Fewer than 2 payments in the last hour? Block it.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h < 2 THEN BLOCK reason="low_txns"

prompt: New device with fewer than 10 payments in the last hour: block if the account is at least 10 days old or the merchant is whitelisted.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 7 AND txn.count_1h < 10 AND (user.account_age_days >= 10 OR merchant.whitelisted) THEN BLOCK reason="new_device_low_txns"

prompt: UPI payments under 5000 should be reviewed.
rule: WHEN txn.method == UPI AND txn.amount < 5000 THEN REVIEW reason="upi_method_low_amount"

prompt: Allow it if it's before 8am or the account is new.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 8 OR user.account_age_days < 30 THEN ALLOW reason="early_hours_new_account"

prompt: Utilities, gaming and travel merchants: blocked.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [UTILITIES, GAMING, TRAVEL] THEN BLOCK reason="listed_merchant"

prompt: Food merchant and account under 3 days old: let it pass.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == FOOD AND user.account_age_days < 3 THEN ALLOW reason="food_merchant_low_account"

prompt: International payments from 9am on are blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.hour >= 9 THEN BLOCK reason="international_late_hours"

prompt: More than 4 failed attempts in 24 hours at night? Block it.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h > 4 AND txn.hour < 6 THEN BLOCK reason="high_failures_night"

prompt: Non-rooted, gaming, account up to 120 days old, device at least 2 days old. Reject.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND merchant.category == GAMING AND user.account_age_days <= 120 AND device.age_days >= 2 THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_gaming_merchant"

prompt: Review when the user has at most 10 failed attempts in 24 hours and the payment is either at night or the user made 25 or fewer payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h <= 10 AND (txn.hour < 6 OR txn.count_1h <= 25) THEN REVIEW reason="low_failures_early_hours"

prompt: Any device first seen less than 30 days ago gets blocked.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 30 THEN BLOCK reason="low_device"

prompt: Send payments to review if the merchant is not whitelisted or the account is at least two years old.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted OR user.account_age_days >= 730 THEN REVIEW reason="unlisted_merchant_high_account"

prompt: Review payments over 4000 from devices 10 days old or more.
rule: WHEN device.age_days >= 10 AND txn.amount > 4000 THEN REVIEW reason="high_device_high_amount"

prompt: When the user made more than 4 payments in the last hour, block if either the account is over a week old or the merchant is electronics or utilities.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h > 4 AND (user.account_age_days > 7 OR merchant.category IN [ELECTRONICS, UTILITIES]) THEN BLOCK reason="high_txns_high_account"

prompt: Allow grocery payments, and allow UPI payments too.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == GROCERY OR txn.method == UPI THEN ALLOW reason="grocery_merchant_upi_method"

prompt: A new account paying a whitelisted merchant internationally should be blocked.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 30 AND txn.is_international AND merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="new_account_international"

prompt: Domestic, non-netbanking payments from accounts up to 90 days old get reviewed when the user has more than 3 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND user.account_age_days <= 90 AND txn.method != NETBANKING AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 3 THEN REVIEW reason="domestic_low_account"

prompt: KYC-verified users paying domestic non-whitelisted merchants from a device older than 180 days get blocked.
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND NOT merchant.whitelisted AND device.age_days > 180 AND NOT txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="kyc_verified_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: Review if the device is at most 2 days old or the amount is 75000 or less.
rule: WHEN device.age_days <= 2 OR txn.amount <= 75000 THEN REVIEW reason="low_device_low_amount"

prompt: Account up to 60 days old, whitelisted merchant, not travel or food, fewer than 25 payments in the last hour: block.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days <= 60 AND merchant.whitelisted AND NOT merchant.category IN [TRAVEL, FOOD] AND txn.count_1h < 25 THEN BLOCK reason="low_account_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: Send to review if the method is neither netbanking nor wallet, or the user isn't KYC-verified, or the merchant is food. Any one of those is enough.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.method IN [NETBANKING, WALLET] OR NOT user.kyc_verified OR merchant.category == FOOD THEN REVIEW reason="listed_method_no_kyc"

prompt: Refuse it if the device is 120 days old or less, or the payment is international. Either one.
rule: WHEN device.age_days <= 120 OR txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="low_device_international"

prompt: Rooted devices get reviewed when the user is either not KYC-verified or on a device at most 14 days old.
rule: WHEN (NOT user.kyc_verified OR device.age_days <= 14) AND device.is_rooted THEN REVIEW reason="no_kyc_low_device"

prompt: Travel payments from accounts under 5 days old are blocked.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == TRAVEL AND user.account_age_days < 5 THEN BLOCK reason="travel_merchant_low_account"

prompt: Rooted device, KYC-verified user, netbanking, travel merchant: manual review.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND user.kyc_verified AND txn.method == NETBANKING AND merchant.category == TRAVEL THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_device_kyc_verified"

prompt: Non-KYC users at non-whitelisted merchants get reviewed when they have 3 or more failed attempts in the last 24 hours or the time is before 9am.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND NOT merchant.whitelisted AND (user.failed_attempts_24h >= 3 OR txn.hour < 9) THEN REVIEW reason="no_kyc_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: Review wallet or UPI payments, and also review grocery or utilities payments.
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [WALLET, UPI] OR merchant.category IN [GROCERY, UTILITIES] THEN REVIEW reason="listed_method_listed_merchant"

prompt: UPI or netbanking payments of up to 30k to grocery, electronics or utilities merchants are allowed.
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [UPI, NETBANKING] AND merchant.category IN [GROCERY, ELECTRONICS, UTILITIES] AND txn.amount <= 30000 THEN ALLOW reason="listed_method_listed_merchant"

prompt: A rooted device under 3 days old paying a whitelisted merchant domestically needs review.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND device.age_days < 3 AND NOT txn.is_international AND merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_device_low_device"

prompt: Block domestic payments, and block any payment coming from a new phone.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international OR device.age_days < 7 THEN BLOCK reason="domestic_new_device"

prompt: Wallet or card payments to grocery from 4am onwards are blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [WALLET, CARD] AND merchant.category == GROCERY AND txn.hour >= 4 THEN BLOCK reason="listed_method_grocery_merchant"

prompt: Non-whitelisted merchant, device under 10 days old, and either a utilities merchant or more than 20 payments in the last hour: block.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND device.age_days < 10 AND (merchant.category == UTILITIES OR txn.count_1h > 20) THEN BLOCK reason="unlisted_merchant_low_device"

prompt: Rooted device, not UPI, gaming merchant, domestic payment: block.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND txn.method != UPI AND merchant.category == GAMING AND NOT txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="rooted_device_upi_method"

prompt: Netbanking payments to non-whitelisted merchants from rooted devices are blocked when the user has made 2 or more payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND device.is_rooted AND txn.method == NETBANKING AND txn.count_1h >= 2 THEN BLOCK reason="unlisted_merchant_rooted_device"

prompt: A domestic payment of up to 50 lakh from a device at most 3 days old gets blocked if the user made more than 20 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN device.age_days <= 3 AND txn.count_1h > 20 AND NOT txn.is_international AND txn.amount <= 5000000 THEN BLOCK reason="low_device_high_txns"

prompt: Electronics payments from accounts up to 45 days old should be blocked.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days <= 45 AND merchant.category == ELECTRONICS THEN BLOCK reason="low_account_electronics_merchant"

prompt: Review a KYC-verified user whose account is over 180 days old, paying grocery, travel or utilities, with 6 or more failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 6 AND merchant.category IN [GROCERY, TRAVEL, UTILITIES] AND user.kyc_verified AND user.account_age_days > 180 THEN REVIEW reason="high_failures_listed_merchant"

prompt: International payments under 500 rupees from users with at most 3 failed attempts in 24 hours go to review.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.amount < 500 AND user.failed_attempts_24h <= 3 THEN REVIEW reason="international_low_amount"

prompt: UPI payments of 2000 or more from 4am onwards are blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.method == UPI AND txn.hour >= 4 AND txn.amount >= 2000 THEN BLOCK reason="upi_method_late_hours"

prompt: Domestic payments by any method except wallet need review.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND txn.method != WALLET THEN REVIEW reason="domestic_wallet_method"

prompt: KYC-verified users can't pay 75k or more.
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND txn.amount >= 75000 THEN BLOCK reason="kyc_verified_high_amount"

prompt: Grocery payments under 75,000 should be reviewed when the user has fewer than 3 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h < 3 AND txn.amount < 75000 AND merchant.category == GROCERY THEN REVIEW reason="low_failures_low_amount"

prompt: Users without KYC paying non-whitelisted merchants are blocked if they have made at most 4 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.count_1h <= 4 THEN BLOCK reason="unlisted_merchant_no_kyc"

prompt: Payments of 10,000 or more from a device older than 120 days need review.
rule: WHEN device.age_days > 120 AND txn.amount >= 10000 THEN REVIEW reason="high_device_high_amount"

prompt: International payments by KYC-verified users are allowed when either the merchant is not utilities or the account is under 30 days old.
rule: WHEN (merchant.category != UTILITIES OR user.account_age_days < 30) AND txn.is_international AND user.kyc_verified THEN ALLOW reason="utilities_merchant_new_account"

prompt: Food payments by card or UPI from 7pm onward go to review.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 19 AND txn.method IN [CARD, UPI] AND merchant.category == FOOD THEN REVIEW reason="late_hours_listed_method"

prompt: Non-grocery payments of up to 50k are allowed.
rule: WHEN txn.amount <= 50000 AND merchant.category != GROCERY THEN ALLOW reason="low_amount_grocery_merchant"

prompt: Review if the device isn't rooted, if the account is under 2 days old, or if it's 10am or later.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted OR user.account_age_days < 2 OR txn.hour >= 10 THEN REVIEW reason="unrooted_device_low_account"

prompt: International payments under 50 lakh are blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.amount < 5000000 AND txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="low_amount_international"

prompt: Allow it if the amount is 500 or more, or if it falls between 6pm and 10pm.
rule: WHEN txn.amount >= 500 OR txn.hour >= 18 AND txn.hour < 22 THEN ALLOW reason="high_amount_window_hours"

prompt: Electronics payments are allowed.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == ELECTRONICS THEN ALLOW reason="electronics_merchant"

prompt: More than 12 payments in the last hour from a user without KYC should be reviewed.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h > 12 AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN REVIEW reason="high_txns_no_kyc"

prompt: New accounts spending more than 2000 rupees get reviewed.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 30 AND txn.amount > 2000 THEN REVIEW reason="new_account_high_amount"

prompt: Before 6am, device not rooted, account at most a day old: review.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 6 AND NOT device.is_rooted AND user.account_age_days <= 1 THEN REVIEW reason="night_unrooted_device"

prompt: Gaming or travel payments between 9am and 5pm can be allowed if the user has 6 or more failed attempts in 24 hours and the device is new.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 6 AND device.age_days < 7 AND merchant.category IN [GAMING, TRAVEL] AND txn.hour >= 9 AND txn.hour < 17 THEN ALLOW reason="high_failures_new_device"

prompt: Payments up to 80k where the user has at most 8 failed attempts in the last 24 hours go to review.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h <= 8 AND txn.amount <= 80000 THEN REVIEW reason="low_failures_low_amount"

prompt: Non-card payments at night get reviewed when the user has made fewer than 25 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.method != CARD AND txn.hour < 6 AND txn.count_1h < 25 THEN REVIEW reason="card_method_night"

prompt: Rooted devices at least 3 days old are blocked if the user made at most 30 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND txn.count_1h <= 30 AND device.age_days >= 3 THEN BLOCK reason="rooted_device_low_txns"

prompt: International payments from a rooted device under 60 days old, paid by UPI, netbanking or card: review.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND device.age_days < 60 AND device.is_rooted AND txn.method IN [UPI, NETBANKING, CARD] THEN REVIEW reason="international_low_device"

prompt: Allow international payments at night from accounts at least 10 days old with at most 4 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.hour < 6 AND user.failed_attempts_24h <= 4 AND user.account_age_days >= 10 THEN ALLOW reason="international_early_hours"

prompt: Electronics and food merchants are allowed.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [ELECTRONICS, FOOD] THEN ALLOW reason="listed_merchant"

prompt: International payments from accounts a week old or less: block.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND user.account_age_days <= 7 THEN BLOCK reason="international_low_account"

prompt: Review accounts over 30 days old that haven't done KYC.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days > 30 AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN REVIEW reason="high_account_no_kyc"

prompt: Unverified users between 8pm and 11pm are blocked.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.hour >= 20 AND txn.hour < 23 THEN BLOCK reason="no_kyc_window_hours"

prompt: International food payments from accounts at least three months old get blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND user.account_age_days >= 90 AND merchant.category == FOOD THEN BLOCK reason="international_high_account"

prompt: KYC-verified users on devices at least a week old paying a whitelisted merchant: block.
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND device.age_days >= 7 AND merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="kyc_verified_high_device"

prompt: Whitelisted merchant, no failed attempts in 24 hours, under 8 payments in the last hour, device older than 45 days: send to review.
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND user.failed_attempts_24h == 0 AND txn.count_1h < 8 AND device.age_days > 45 THEN REVIEW reason="whitelisted_merchant_no_failures"

prompt: For unverified users making international payments, review if the account is over 21 days old or the merchant is travel.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND (user.account_age_days > 21 OR merchant.category == TRAVEL) THEN REVIEW reason="international_no_kyc"

prompt: International payments from non-rooted devices on accounts up to 30 days old should be reviewed, unless the method is wallet.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.is_international AND txn.method != WALLET AND user.account_age_days <= 30 THEN REVIEW reason="unrooted_device_international"

prompt: Allow electronics or food merchants, or users with more than 6 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [ELECTRONICS, FOOD] OR user.failed_attempts_24h > 6 THEN ALLOW reason="listed_merchant_high_failures"

prompt: Payments up to 75000 are blocked if the user made more than 12 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.amount <= 75000 AND txn.count_1h > 12 THEN BLOCK reason="low_amount_high_txns"

prompt: Rooted device, electronics, up to 7.5 lakh, device at most 3 days old. Block.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND merchant.category == ELECTRONICS AND txn.amount <= 750000 AND device.age_days <= 3 THEN BLOCK reason="rooted_device_electronics_merchant"

prompt: From 3pm onwards, or more than 20 payments in the last hour: reject.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 15 OR txn.count_1h > 20 THEN BLOCK reason="late_hours_high_txns"

prompt: Reject when the user has fewer than 20 failed attempts in 24 hours, and also when the device is new.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h < 20 OR device.age_days < 7 THEN BLOCK reason="low_failures_new_device"

prompt: Payments before 3pm from users with more than 2 failed attempts in 24 hours get reviewed.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 15 AND user.failed_attempts_24h > 2 THEN REVIEW reason="early_hours_high_failures"

prompt: A payment of exactly 3000 rupees from an account up to 5 days old gets blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.amount == 3000 AND user.account_age_days <= 5 THEN BLOCK reason="exact_amount_low_account"

prompt: Deny it when the device is at most 30 days old, the amount is 200 or less, and either the account is under a year old or the time is before 7pm.
rule: WHEN (user.account_age_days < 365 OR txn.hour < 19) AND txn.amount <= 200 AND device.age_days <= 30 THEN BLOCK reason="low_account_early_hours"

prompt: Any one of these gets blocked: a whitelisted merchant, an amount of 750 or more, or a device under 30 days old.
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted OR txn.amount >= 750 OR device.age_days < 30 THEN BLOCK reason="whitelisted_merchant_high_amount"

prompt: Whitelisted merchants are allowed when the amount is under 40k or it's night.
rule: WHEN (txn.amount < 40000 OR txn.hour < 6) AND merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="low_amount_night"

prompt: Netbanking payments from non-rooted devices are blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.method == NETBANKING AND NOT device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="netbanking_method_unrooted_device"

prompt: Disallow it if the device is at most 2 days old or the method is neither card nor netbanking.
rule: WHEN device.age_days <= 2 OR NOT txn.method IN [CARD, NETBANKING] THEN BLOCK reason="low_device_listed_method"

prompt: Account under 2 days old on a new device with fewer than 15 failed attempts: block.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h < 15 AND user.account_age_days < 2 AND device.age_days < 7 THEN BLOCK reason="low_failures_low_account"

prompt: Allow exactly 2000 rupees from verified users on non-rooted devices if the method is neither netbanking nor UPI.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND user.kyc_verified AND NOT txn.method IN [NETBANKING, UPI] AND txn.amount == 2000 THEN ALLOW reason="unrooted_device_kyc_verified"

prompt: Food, grocery and utilities payments from non-rooted devices are blocked.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [FOOD, GROCERY, UTILITIES] AND NOT device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="listed_merchant_unrooted_device"

prompt: Users with 15 or more failed attempts in 24 hours are blocked if the device is rooted or it's 10am or later.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 15 AND (device.is_rooted OR txn.hour >= 10) THEN BLOCK reason="high_failures_rooted_device"

prompt: Utilities, travel and grocery merchants are blocked, and so is anything from 10pm onwards.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [UTILITIES, TRAVEL, GROCERY] OR txn.hour >= 22 THEN BLOCK reason="listed_merchant_late_hours"

prompt: Review international payments from accounts under 90 days old on a device that has been seen for more than a day.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 90 AND device.age_days > 1 AND txn.is_international THEN REVIEW reason="low_account_high_device"

prompt: Utilities and food payments from verified users with 4 or more failed attempts in 24 hours can pass.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [UTILITIES, FOOD] AND user.kyc_verified AND user.failed_attempts_24h >= 4 THEN ALLOW reason="listed_merchant_kyc_verified"

prompt: Block when the account is at least 15 days old, or the device isn't rooted, or the user has more than 15 failed attempts. Any one is enough.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days >= 15 OR NOT device.is_rooted OR user.failed_attempts_24h > 15 THEN BLOCK reason="high_account_unrooted_device"

prompt: Unverified user, rooted device, 8 or more payments in the last hour: block.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.count_1h >= 8 AND device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="no_kyc_high_txns"

prompt: From 2am onwards, block users who made more than 15 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h > 15 AND txn.hour >= 2 THEN BLOCK reason="high_txns_late_hours"

prompt: New devices that are not rooted need a review.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 7 AND NOT device.is_rooted THEN REVIEW reason="new_device_unrooted_device"

prompt: Accounts at least 60 days old that made at most 2 payments in the last hour get blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h <= 2 AND user.account_age_days >= 60 THEN BLOCK reason="low_txns_high_account"

prompt: Travel payments from KYC-verified accounts under 5 days old are blocked.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 5 AND merchant.category == TRAVEL AND user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="low_account_travel_merchant"

prompt: Whitelisted merchant, 6 or more failed attempts in 24 hours, amount 20,000 or less: block.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 6 AND txn.amount <= 20000 AND merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="high_failures_low_amount"

prompt: Allow netbanking payments from accounts under 5 days old if the user made 50 or more payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 50 AND user.account_age_days < 5 AND txn.method == NETBANKING THEN ALLOW reason="high_txns_low_account"

prompt: A payment of exactly 1500 is blocked when the user made at most 2 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.amount == 1500 AND txn.count_1h <= 2 THEN BLOCK reason="exact_amount_low_txns"

prompt: Unverified users paying by UPI before 1pm with 20 or more failed attempts in 24 hours should be reviewed.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 13 AND user.failed_attempts_24h >= 20 AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.method == UPI THEN REVIEW reason="early_hours_high_failures"

prompt: Rooted devices are blocked before 11pm.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 23 AND device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="early_hours_rooted_device"

prompt: Accounts 10 days old or more: blocked.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days >= 10 THEN BLOCK reason="high_account"

prompt: Non-rooted devices that were first seen at least 30 days ago get reviewed.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND device.age_days >= 30 THEN REVIEW reason="unrooted_device_high_device"

prompt: Block international payments where the user made at most 8 payments in the last hour, and also block exactly 2500 rupees.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.count_1h <= 8 OR txn.amount == 2500 THEN BLOCK reason="international_low_txns"

prompt: Grocery payments get reviewed when the user made fewer than 8 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == GROCERY AND txn.count_1h < 8 THEN REVIEW reason="grocery_merchant_low_txns"

prompt: Whitelisted merchants before 5am are blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 5 AND merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="early_hours_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: Non-UPI payments on a non-rooted device are allowed if it's from 5pm onwards or it's domestic.
rule: WHEN (txn.hour >= 17 OR NOT txn.is_international) AND txn.method != UPI AND NOT device.is_rooted THEN ALLOW reason="late_hours_domestic"

prompt: KYC-verified users on rooted devices who made 25 or fewer payments in the last hour get blocked.
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND device.is_rooted AND txn.count_1h <= 25 THEN BLOCK reason="kyc_verified_rooted_device"

prompt: Block payments from users who made at most 6 payments in the last hour, if either the device is not rooted or the payment is international.
rule: WHEN (NOT device.is_rooted OR txn.is_international) AND txn.count_1h <= 6 THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_international"

prompt: Non-UPI payments under 12k are allowed if the merchant is whitelisted or the user made at least 2 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN (merchant.whitelisted OR txn.count_1h >= 2) AND txn.method != UPI AND txn.amount < 12000 THEN ALLOW reason="whitelisted_merchant_high_txns"

prompt: Block a new device when the account is up to 14 days old or the amount is under 7500.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 7 AND (user.account_age_days <= 14 OR txn.amount < 7500) THEN BLOCK reason="new_device_low_account"

prompt: Rooted non-UPI payments of up to 50 lakh to merchants that aren't travel get blocked.
rule: WHEN merchant.category != TRAVEL AND device.is_rooted AND txn.method != UPI AND txn.amount <= 5000000 THEN BLOCK reason="travel_merchant_rooted_device"

prompt: Non-KYC payments of 2 lakh or more are allowed when the user made fewer than 12 payments in the last hour and has fewer than 3 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN txn.amount >= 200000 AND txn.count_1h < 12 AND user.failed_attempts_24h < 3 AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN ALLOW reason="high_amount_low_txns"

prompt: KYC-verified users paying any merchant but travel are blocked.
rule: WHEN merchant.category != TRAVEL AND user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="travel_merchant_kyc_verified"

prompt: Payments of 35k or more get blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.amount >= 35000 THEN BLOCK reason="high_amount"

prompt: Block unverified users on non-rooted devices. Also block anyone with more than 2 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND NOT device.is_rooted OR txn.count_1h > 2 THEN BLOCK reason="no_kyc_unrooted_device"

prompt: Whitelisted merchants from 8pm on are allowed when the user has more than 20 failed attempts and fewer than 5 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h > 20 AND txn.count_1h < 5 AND merchant.whitelisted AND txn.hour >= 20 THEN ALLOW reason="high_failures_low_txns"

prompt: Rooted devices with an amount of 35k or less go to review.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND txn.amount <= 35000 THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_device_low_amount"

prompt: Block payments of 3000 or less before 9pm from accounts up to 120 days old.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 21 AND user.account_age_days <= 120 AND txn.amount <= 3000 THEN BLOCK reason="early_hours_low_account"

prompt: Domestic payments of 2 lakh or more are blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.amount >= 200000 AND NOT txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="high_amount_domestic"

prompt: International card payments to utilities or electronics merchants should be reviewed.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [UTILITIES, ELECTRONICS] AND txn.method == CARD AND txn.is_international THEN REVIEW reason="listed_merchant_card_method"

prompt: Payments over 15k are blocked when the merchant is whitelisted or the device is new.
rule: WHEN (merchant.whitelisted OR device.age_days < 7) AND txn.amount > 15000 THEN BLOCK reason="whitelisted_merchant_new_device"

prompt: Non-card payments from devices at most a day old on accounts at least 10 days old get blocked.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days >= 10 AND txn.method != CARD AND device.age_days <= 1 THEN BLOCK reason="high_account_card_method"

prompt: Whitelisted travel merchants are blocked when the account is at least 60 days old and the user has fewer than 20 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND user.failed_attempts_24h < 20 AND merchant.category == TRAVEL AND user.account_age_days >= 60 THEN BLOCK reason="whitelisted_merchant_low_failures"

prompt: International payments with 30 or more payments in the last hour are blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 30 AND txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="high_txns_international"

prompt: Non-rooted netbanking payments before 11pm are blocked.
rule: WHEN NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.method == NETBANKING AND txn.hour < 23 THEN BLOCK reason="unrooted_device_netbanking_method"

prompt: Review payments in the midnight hour, before 1am.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 1 THEN REVIEW reason="early_hours"

prompt: Allow non-KYC users on non-rooted devices to pay gaming, grocery or food merchants if they made at most 15 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.count_1h <= 15 AND NOT device.is_rooted AND merchant.category IN [GAMING, GROCERY, FOOD] THEN ALLOW reason="no_kyc_low_txns"

prompt: Whitelisted merchants over 250 rupees from non-rooted devices are blocked from 5am onwards.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 5 AND merchant.whitelisted AND NOT device.is_rooted AND txn.amount > 250 THEN BLOCK reason="late_hours_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: Electronics payments of 200 or less from 2pm onwards are blocked when the account is over 2 days old.
rule: WHEN txn.amount <= 200 AND txn.hour >= 14 AND merchant.category == ELECTRONICS AND user.account_age_days > 2 THEN BLOCK reason="low_amount_late_hours"

prompt: Allow it if the user made at most 4 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h <= 4 THEN ALLOW reason="low_txns"

prompt: International payments are allowed for users with at most 6 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND user.failed_attempts_24h <= 6 THEN ALLOW reason="international_low_failures"

prompt: Devices under a year old, or accounts a day old or less, get reviewed.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 365 OR user.account_age_days <= 1 THEN REVIEW reason="low_device_low_account"

prompt: International payments up to 2500 rupees are blocked if the method is card or the user made fewer than 100 payments in the last hour.
rule: WHEN (txn.method == CARD OR txn.count_1h < 100) AND txn.is_international AND txn.amount <= 2500 THEN BLOCK reason="card_method_low_txns"

prompt: Users with more than 1 failed attempt and fewer than 25 payments in the last hour get blocked.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h > 1 AND txn.count_1h < 25 THEN BLOCK reason="high_failures_low_txns"

prompt: International payments of 500 or more from accounts under two weeks old are blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.amount >= 500 AND user.account_age_days < 14 THEN BLOCK reason="international_high_amount"

prompt: Non-netbanking payments from 3am onwards are allowed.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 3 AND txn.method != NETBANKING THEN ALLOW reason="late_hours_netbanking_method"

prompt: Whitelisted utilities merchants from 5pm on get blocked when the user has more than 1 failed attempt in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h > 1 AND merchant.whitelisted AND merchant.category == UTILITIES AND txn.hour >= 17 THEN BLOCK reason="high_failures_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: Gaming payments are blocked when the user has at most 5 failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == GAMING AND user.failed_attempts_24h <= 5 THEN BLOCK reason="gaming_merchant_low_failures"

prompt: KYC-verified users who pay internationally or at night are blocked.
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND (txn.is_international OR txn.hour < 6) THEN BLOCK reason="kyc_verified_international"

prompt: International payments above 2.5 lakh are allowed.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.amount > 250000 THEN ALLOW reason="international_high_amount"

prompt: Accounts up to 5 days old are blocked, and so are users with 4 or fewer failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days <= 5 OR user.failed_attempts_24h <= 4 THEN BLOCK reason="low_account_low_failures"

prompt: Whitelisted merchants are blocked when the user has 4 or more failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND user.failed_attempts_24h >= 4 THEN BLOCK reason="whitelisted_merchant_high_failures"

prompt: Card payments from users with no failed attempts in 24 hours should be reviewed.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h == 0 AND txn.method == CARD THEN REVIEW reason="no_failures_card_method"

prompt: International payments from 7am on are blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.hour >= 7 THEN BLOCK reason="international_late_hours"

prompt: Everything from 11am onwards should be reviewed.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 11 THEN REVIEW reason="late_hours"

prompt: Payments of 1 crore or more from a new device by users with 3 or more failed attempts are blocked, except food merchants.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 7 AND txn.amount >= 10000000 AND merchant.category != FOOD AND user.failed_attempts_24h >= 3 THEN BLOCK reason="new_device_high_amount"

prompt: Allow non-gaming payments from unverified users if they made at most 30 payments in the last hour or didn't use a card.
rule: WHEN merchant.category != GAMING AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND (txn.count_1h <= 30 OR txn.method != CARD) THEN ALLOW reason="gaming_merchant_no_kyc"

prompt: International payments before 1am are blocked unless the method is card or netbanking.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.method IN [CARD, NETBANKING] AND txn.is_international AND txn.hour < 1 THEN BLOCK reason="listed_method_international"

prompt: Allow anything before 11am. Also allow non-gaming payments to merchants that aren't whitelisted, at any hour.
rule: WHEN merchant.category != GAMING AND NOT merchant.whitelisted OR txn.hour < 11 THEN ALLOW reason="gaming_merchant_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: KYC-verified users are blocked before 11am.
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND txn.hour < 11 THEN BLOCK reason="kyc_verified_early_hours"

prompt: Users with at most 2 failed attempts in 24 hours get reviewed if the merchant isn't whitelisted or isn't electronics or grocery.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h <= 2 AND (NOT merchant.category IN [ELECTRONICS, GROCERY] OR NOT merchant.whitelisted) THEN REVIEW reason="low_failures_listed_merchant"

prompt: International payments from 8pm onwards go to review if the method is UPI or netbanking, or the device is at least 3 days old.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 20 AND txn.is_international AND (txn.method IN [UPI, NETBANKING] OR device.age_days >= 3) THEN REVIEW reason="late_hours_international"

prompt: Block accounts at most 2 days old, whitelisted merchants, and KYC-verified users. Any one is enough.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days <= 2 OR merchant.whitelisted OR user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="low_account_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: New accounts paying non-whitelisted merchants are allowed.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 30 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="new_account_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: Users with fewer than 10 failed attempts paying a non-whitelisted merchant are blocked if they are KYC-verified or the device isn't rooted.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h < 10 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted AND (user.kyc_verified OR NOT device.is_rooted) THEN BLOCK reason="low_failures_unlisted_merchant"

prompt: Devices at most 45 days old, or whitelisted merchants, are blocked before 6pm.
rule: WHEN (device.age_days <= 45 OR merchant.whitelisted) AND txn.hour < 18 THEN BLOCK reason="low_device_whitelisted_merchant"

prompt: Gaming or utilities merchants, and international payments, get reviewed.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [GAMING, UTILITIES] OR txn.is_international THEN REVIEW reason="listed_merchant_international"

prompt: Grocery, gaming and food payments are blocked when the user has no failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [GROCERY, GAMING, FOOD] AND user.failed_attempts_24h < 1 THEN BLOCK reason="listed_merchant_low_failures"

prompt: Payments over 7.5 lakh from non-rooted devices should be reviewed.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 750000 AND NOT device.is_rooted THEN REVIEW reason="high_amount_unrooted_device"

prompt: KYC-verified users before 4am are blocked if the method isn't card or netbanking.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.method IN [CARD, NETBANKING] AND txn.hour < 4 AND user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="listed_method_early_hours"

prompt: Unverified users with 6 or more failed attempts in 24 hours get reviewed.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND user.failed_attempts_24h >= 6 THEN REVIEW reason="no_kyc_high_failures"

prompt: Unverified users from 8pm onwards are blocked if the device is at least 3 days old.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 20 AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND device.age_days >= 3 THEN BLOCK reason="late_hours_no_kyc"

prompt: Grocery payments before 8am are allowed for users with 15 or more failed attempts in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 15 AND merchant.category == GROCERY AND txn.hour < 8 THEN ALLOW reason="high_failures_grocery_merchant"

prompt: International payments on a non-rooted device that is 21 days old or less need review.
rule: WHEN device.age_days <= 21 AND txn.is_international AND NOT device.is_rooted THEN REVIEW reason="low_device_international"

prompt: Unverified users with more than 8 failed attempts, 20k or more, and 25 or more payments in the last hour get blocked.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h > 8 AND txn.amount >= 20000 AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.count_1h >= 25 THEN BLOCK reason="high_failures_high_amount"

prompt: Devices at most 120 days old with 100 or more payments in the last hour: review.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 100 AND device.age_days <= 120 THEN REVIEW reason="high_txns_low_device"
